//TR: C-RDY-1 (Rol Hazırlık Denetçisi) için YENİDEN ÜRETİLEBİLİR mutant listesi: her kayıt core/agents/readiness-audit.ts içinde TAM 1 kez geçen bir metni değiştirir; docs/lanes/LANE-C-readiness-audit-mutants.mjs hepsini tests/v7-core-readiness-audit.test.ts ile çalıştırır ve her birinin ÖLDÜRÜLMESİNİ (KILLED) bekler. M1-M13 koordinatör paketindeki zorunlu mutantlardır; M14-M25 ek savunma mutantlarıdır (DEFINED küme uyuşmazlığı, PROFILED teknoloji durumu, yoklama, kaynak sınıfı/tarih, EVALUATED nedeni, aşama NO_CODE_PATH, anomali, uzlaştırma alanları ve yükleyicinin fail-closed davranışı).

mutants.description: EXECUTABLE from the resolver label: the PRODUCTION_EXECUTOR_ROUTES / STAGE_CONSUMERS condition is dropped, so TRUE becomes 9 (UASCO-0232 counts)
proposedProfiles candidate skills are counted as canonical skills
EVALUATED ignores verify() and the FAKE check (any non-NOT_EXECUTED spec counts)
RUNNING is FALSE (measured zero) instead of UNKNOWN when the journal is ABSENT
KNOWLEDGE_READY accepts a unit with empty sourceRefs (vacuous every())
TOOL_READY is TRUE (from the non-empty adapter strings) when adapterReality is absent
stageWired defaults to TRUE (the code path) when reachableStages is undefined
KNOWLEDGE_READY is TRUE with empty requiredTechnologies (vacuous every())
PROFILED is TRUE with empty requiredTechnologies
PROMOTED_TECHNOLOGY_STATUSES contains CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED (every role is suddenly promoted)
mutants.old: export const PROMOTED_TECHNOLOGY_STATUSES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>();
mutants.new: export const PROMOTED_TECHNOLOGY_STATUSES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>(["CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED"]);

mutants.description: byGuild is built only from the roles' guildIds (the guilds[] union is dropped, empty guilds vanish)
the digest includes computedAt (it changes with now)
the legacy reconciliation ignores the byGuild rows
DEFINED ignores a role whose clusterId differs from its guild's cluster
PROFILED ignores the per-technology status (no promoted check)
TOOL_READY treats a NOT_OBSERVED probe as passed
KNOWLEDGE_READY does not check that sourceClass is allowed for certification
KNOWLEDGE_READY does not check lastValidatedAt
EVALUATED reports every executed-but-unverified claim as NO_SPEC_EXECUTED (EVIDENCE_REJECTED is lost)
mutants.old: else evaluated = specs.every(s => s.status === "NOT_EXECUTED") ? result("FALSE", ["NO_SPEC_EXECUTED"]) : result("FALSE", ["EVIDENCE_REJECTED"]);

mutants.description: stageWired does not require the code path (a role without a binding is not NO_CODE_PATH)
the RUNNING-without-EXECUTABLE layer-order anomaly is not raised
the reconciliation always claims runningMeasured
implementedStageWired reports a number when reachableStages was not supplied
the loader substitutes an empty array for a missing/non-array registry field (fail-open)
the loader no longer restricts technology slugs (a slug can read outside knowledge/technologies)
